description.value: Sabra is a Glatt Kosher and Halal restaurant and bakery in Vancouver, founded in 1992 by the Kahlon family and supervised by the Orthodox Rabbinical Council of British Columbia. The menu blends ethnic, West Coast fusion, and traditional meat and parve dishes alongside an extensive Jewish bakery offering — challah, babka, rugelach, and custom cakes. Eat-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, and catering is offered for events ranging from Shabbat dinners to weddings.
